msg.content:
1	# Submodule: Countries / API / Params
     2	
     3	## Purpose
     4	
     5	Individual parameter classes, interfaces, and validation classes for Countries API
     6	parameter management. Covers both the **single-value** path (one country per request)
     7	and the **multi-value** path (one or more countries per request).
     8	
     9	---
    10	
    11	## Class Overview
    12	
    13	### Interfaces
    14	
    15	| Class | Description |
    16	|---|---|
    17	| `AppCountryParamInterface` | Singular interface — extends `APIParameterInterface`, declares `getCountry(): ?Application_Countries_Country`. Implemented by `AppCountryIDParam` and `AppCountryISOParam`. |
    18	| `AppCountriesParamInterface` | Plural interface — extends `APIParameterInterface`, declares `getCountries(): Application_Countries_Country[]`. Implemented by `AppCountryIDsParam` and (once available) `AppCountryISOsParam`. |
    19	
    20	### Single-Value Parameters (`AppCountryAPITrait` path)
    21	
    22	| Class | Base | Parameter name | Validation |
    23	|---|---|---|---|
    24	| `AppCountryIDParam` | `IntegerParameter` | `countryID` | `validateByValueExistsCallback` — checks `idExists()` |
    25	| `AppCountryISOParam` | `StringParameter` | `countryISO` | `validateByValueExistsCallback` — checks `isoExists()` |
    26	
    27	### Multi-Value Parameters (`AppCountriesAPITrait` path)
    28	
    29	| Class | Base | Parameter name | Validation |
    30	|---|---|---|---|
    31	| `AppCountryIDsParam` | `IDListParameter` | `countryIDs` | `AppCountryIDsValidation` — per-ID error messages |
    32	| `AppCountryISOsParam` | `StringListParameter` | `countryISOs` | `AppCountryISOsValidation` — per-ISO error messages |
    33	
    34	### Handlers
    35	
    36	| Class | Bridges |
    37	|---|---|
    38	| `AppCountryIDHandler` | `AppCountryIDParam` → `AppCountryParamsContainer` |
    39	| `AppCountryISOHandler` | `AppCountryISOParam` → `AppCountryParamsContainer` |
    40	| `AppCountryIDsHandler` | `AppCountryIDsParam` → `AppCountriesParamsContainer` |
    41	| `AppCountryISOsHandler` | `AppCountryISOsParam` → `AppCountriesParamsContainer` |
    42	
    43	### Validation
    44	
    45	| Class | Validates | Error code |
    46	|---|---|---|
    47	| `AppCountryIDsValidation` | Each country ID in an `int[]` list individually | `VALIDATION_COUNTRY_ID_NOT_EXISTS = 184801` |
    48	| `AppCountryISOsValidation` | Each country ISO code in a `string[]` list individually | `VALIDATION_COUNTRY_ISO_NOT_EXISTS = 184802` |
    49	
    50	---
    51	
    52	## `AppCountryIDsValidation` — Design Note
    53	
    54	`AppCountryIDsValidation` extends `BaseParamValidation` rather than using
    55	`validateByValueExistsCallback()`. This is intentional: the callback variant
    56	receives the **entire resolved array** as a single argument, so it can only
    57	report pass/fail for the list as a whole. `AppCountryIDsValidation` iterates
    58	each ID individually, collecting all invalid IDs into a single error message
    59	that identifies exactly which values are rejected. This gives API consumers
    60	complete feedback in one round-trip rather than requiring repeated requests
    61	to discover each invalid ID.
    62	
    63	---
    64	
    65	## Parameter Constant Ownership Note
    66	
    67	Both `AppCountryIDsParam` (`PARAM_COUNTRY_IDS = 'countryIDs'`) and
    68	`AppCountryISOsParam` (`PARAM_COUNTRY_ISOS = 'countryISOs'`) declare their
    69	parameter name constants locally because `AppCountriesAPIInterface` does not
    70	exist until a later work package. Once that interface is available, the
    71	duplication should be resolved: either the param classes reference
    72	`AppCountriesAPIInterface::PARAM_COUNTRY_*`, or the interface references the
    73	param class constants (preferred if param classes are the canonical owners).
    74	
    75	---
    76	
    77	## `AppCountriesParamInterface` — Implementations
    78	
    79	`AppCountriesParamInterface` is implemented by:
    80	- `AppCountryIDsParam` — resolves countries from integer IDs
    81	- `AppCountryISOsParam` — resolves countries from ISO codes
    82	
    83	---
    84	
    85	## Integration Points
    86	
    87	- **Handlers** are composed by `AppCountryParamsContainer` (singular) and `AppCountriesParamsContainer` (plural), which are managed by their respective trait methods.
    88	- **`IDListParameter`** (in `Application\API\Parameters\Type`) is the base for `AppCountryIDsParam`.
    89	- **`StringListParameter`** (in `Application\API\Parameters\Type`) will be the base for `AppCountryISOsParam` (WP-003).
    90	- **`BaseParamValidation`** (in `Application\API\Parameters\Validation`) is the base for `AppCountryIDsValidation`.
    91	- **`AppFactory::createCountries()`** provides the `Countries` collection for all existence checks.
